hypotheses.description: Global tick scaling outruns the active generic timer IRQ path and corrupts interrupt return state.
hypotheses.testable_condition: Disable scaled ticking while CNTP/CNTV is enabled and unmasked; the old panic should disappear.

evidence_criteria.confirm: Rebuilt `--tick-scale=100` boot no longer hits the old kernel panic.
evidence_criteria.reject: The same `ffffffbfbeaf0000` panic still occurs after gating tick scaling.

hypotheses.description: The fault is caused by an unrelated scheduler callback pointer corruption independent of timer acceleration.
hypotheses.testable_condition: The panic should remain after disabling scaled ticking during live timer IRQ delivery.

evidence_criteria.confirm: Old panic remains unchanged after the mitigation.
evidence_criteria.reject: Old panic disappears and execution moves beyond the previous failure point.
